system.description: Also at 6th level, you've learned to weaponize pressure itself. Every shove, every feint, every lock of your grip is calculated to break your rival’s focus and rhythm. When you perform a Skill based action, targeting your Combat Rival, if you succeed the check, they suffer disadvantage on their next attack roll and you regain 1 Superiority Die. You can regain a Superiority Die in this way, once per turn.
